questions.q: Constipation in infants with hard stools that recede after being partly expelled ('bashful stool') suggests:
questions.why: Topic 7, Practice of Medicine. Silicea's shy stool.

questions.q: Thick, horny callosities on the soles, split nails and a sentimental mood in the moonlight indicate:
questions.why: Antimonium crudum: horny callosities and warts, cracked nails, sentimental in moonlight (Boericke).

questions.q: The 'bagel sign' on ultrasound is seen in (GPSC Medical Officer, 2024):
questions.why: Topic 8, Obstetrics, Gynaecology and Paediatrics. Tubal ring sign; a molar pregnancy gives a snowstorm appearance.

questions.q: Under Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram (RBSK), children are screened for defects at birth, diseases, deficiencies and:
questions.why: RBSK screens children aged 0-18 years for the '4 Ds': defects at birth, diseases, deficiencies and developmental delays including disability.

questions.q: Hoarseness and loss of voice with a raw, sore larynx; paralytic weakness and sympathy for others' suffering suggest:
questions.why: Topic 2, Materia Medica. Causticum: paralytic weakness, deep sympathy, hoarseness worse mornings.

questions.q: Bed-wetting in an irritable child who picks at the nose, grinds the teeth in sleep and has a canine hunger calls for:
questions.why: Cina is the classic worm remedy with nose-boring, teeth grinding, ravenous hunger and nocturnal enuresis.

questions.q: In chronic miasmatic diseases, Hahnemann taught that several antipsoric remedies may be needed:
opts: one after another, each given singly according to the changing symptoms
questions.why: Topic 1, Organon and Philosophy. Each prescription follows the new picture.

questions.q: Anaemia with pallor, in which the face flushes fiery red on the least emotion or exertion (false plethora), calls for:
questions.why: Ferrum met: anaemic yet with false plethora; face flushes red on the least pain, emotion or exertion (Allen's Keynotes).

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a vehicle in homoeopathic pharmacy?
questions.why: Vehicles are neutral carriers with no medicinal action. Sulphur is a medicinal substance.

questions.q: Preventing the emergence of risk factors (such as unhealthy diets) in a population where they have not yet appeared is called:
questions.why: Primordial prevention acts before risk factors arise, mainly by health education and lifestyle change in children.
